title: Grade-Level Amounts for Beginning and Middle School Ensemble Members, 2026-27 Fine Arts Fee Schedule — Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
The 2026-27 Fine Arts fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** adds an ensemble-level amount to the participation fee of a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, by the grade on the student's district enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year (Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions): plus 15.00 when it shows grade 06, minus 10.00 when it shows grade 07 or 08, and nothing otherwise.

| Grade on that enrollment record | Ensemble-level amount |
|---|---|
| 06 | plus 15.00 |
| 07 | minus 10.00 |
| 08 | minus 10.00 |
| 09 through 12 | nothing |
| no enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year | nothing |

The amount follows the grade alone, whatever the ensemble or campus: a grade 06 student in any ensemble adds 15.00, and a grade 09 student adds nothing.
